_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for race targets — copy to races.json and fill in your races. race_registry.py reads this file; every tool follows automatically.
_setup: 1) cp races.example.json races.json  2) Rename 'bangsaen' key to your race name  3) Update date, goal_min, location, and expected weather
_key_naming_note: Keep 'bangsaen' as your A-race key (or rename it) and update the values below. The key name is referenced by active_race above.

bangsaen._comment: A-race — rename this key and update all fields for your goal marathon
bangsaen.name: My Goal Marathon
bangsaen._date_help: Change to your race date (YYYY-MM-DD). TRAINING_PHASES in config.py taper to this date.
bangsaen._goal_min_help: Goal time in minutes. 240 = 4:00:00. Set from your VDOT prediction.
bangsaen.note: A-race — update weather fields 2 weeks before race day

my_hm_tuneup._comment: B-race — tune-up half marathon 6-8 weeks before A-race
my_hm_tuneup.name: Tune-up Half Marathon
my_hm_tuneup.note: B-race tune-up — use to confirm VDOT before locking race pace

hm._comment: Generic HM fallback — used by weather_adjuster --race hm. Do not set active:true.
hm.name: Half Marathon (generic)
hm.note: Generic fallback — not a real race

fuji._comment: Archived race example — keep active:false so tools ignore it
fuji.name: Previous Race (archived)
fuji.note: Archived — set active:false to exclude from all tool outputs
